batting.name: VVS Laxman
batting.dismissal: c CA Pujara b TM Dilshan

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: st AB de Villiers b DL Vettori

batting.name: RV Gomez
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b DP Nannes

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c R Vinay Kumar b RA Jadeja

batting.name: TM Dilshan
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b S Sreesanth

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b RV Gomez

balls.text: superb shot. Jadeja steps out to a blockhole delivery and drills it down the ground, timing it well enough to beat the fielder at long-on
Parthiv misses the ball and attempts a bye to the keeper, de Villiers misses the stumps, Zaheer collects and then misses at the bowler's end
Patel tries to hook a short delivery, no one is sure where the ball is, and it eventually ends up near the bowler
another yorker, Jadeja makes room and hits the ball through extra cover
another yorker, superbly bowled, Parthiv defends on the leg side
the yorker from Zaheer, the batsman digs it out on the leg side for a single
a fast short ball, Patel tries to chip it over the wicketkeeper but fails to make contact
short ball, pulled away but not timed well towards midwicket
Gomez lasts one ball. He tried to pull but Nannes was too quick for him. The short ball hurried on to him and the mis-hit lobbed in the air to Tiwary at midwicket
this time he mis-times the ball past the bowler

full ball from Nannes and Jadeja drives the ball dead straight, between the bowler and the stumps, and he's timed it superbly. He cleared his front foot out of the way to make contact with the attempted yorker
Jadeja tries to pull one that angles into him from Nannes and gets into a massive tangle
Hodge charged, and then ended up yorking himself. He tried to dig the ball out on the off but missed. Zaheer uprooted leg stump.
driven to sweeper cover for a single
Jadeja's cleared the sight screen! He moves his front foot out of the way, winds up, and unleashes hell against a length delivery, slamming it with power
the slower ball outside off, driven from the crease towards long-off
Hodge clears his front foot to slam the ball over the boundary but doesn't get under it, he ends up hitting along the ground through midwicket
short and wide outside off, Hodge makes room and cuts the ball in the air but in front of point for two, quick running
a touch short and Jadeja cuts the ball off the back foot towards deep point
Hodge mis-times the pull through midwicket
Hodge aims for down the ground but gets an outside edge that flies wide of de Villiers for four towards third man
tries to slam the ball down the ground this time, instead he mis-times it hard into the pitch and the ball bounces over the bowler's head
Jadeja tries to work the ball off his pads but fails
slants down leg side and Hodge nudges the ball behind square
flicked off the pads towards short fine leg but can't get past the fielder.
played off the pads towards midwicket off the front foot
paddle swept towards short fine leg
Jadeja works the ball off his pads behind square for a single
strides forward and defends towards the bowler

Mahela charges, and isn't to the pitch of the ball. He's beaten in the flight and then has a swing that connects with nothing. de Villiers whips off the bails with the batsman a long way out of his crease
Hodge goes inside out and lofts the drive over cover, he's placed it wide of the fielder on the boundary too
played with an open face towards point
Hodge tries to hit down the ground but gets an inisde edge on to the pad
tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot to cover
makes room by moving towards leg and cuts through point
driven off the front foot towards deep cover
ah Mahela, so delicate, so deft. He waits for the ball outside off and dabs it so very late, beating the fielder at short third man
Mahela mis-times the push on the off and plays it towards the bowler
pulled off the back foot towards wide long-on
Hodge's eyes lit up at a juicy full toss outside off. He tried  to hit it too hard and missed
a loopy yorker from Kohli which Hodge digs out on the off
pulled towards deep midwicket, Mahela wanted the second but decided against it
full toss, flicked towards wide long-on for two more
another one slips down leg
nudged off the pads for a single
full ball outside off, driven with power to the fielder at deep cover
played towards cover
that's wayward down leg side and de Villiers has no chance
a legbreak and considerable turn, played watchfully on the off side
Mahela brings up the 100 by lapping the ball towards short third man
nudged off the back foot between midwicket and mid on for one more
guided towards third man for a single
short ball, very short, and Hodge helps himself to a boundary by pulling through midwicket

the scoop goes wrong for McCullum. He moved a long way outside off, got down on his knees and tried to scoop the ball over the keeper. He had no pace to work with and lobbed a catch to short third man
driven towards deep cover for a single
McCullum drives towards cover and takes a single off Kohli's first ball
Nannes bowls a slower one nearly in the blockhole, McCullum drives past the bowler but doesn't time it too well
there's a wide slip in place but Mahela cuts the ball over the fielder's head towards third man, so deft he is
played from the crease towards point for a well-judged single
Mahela uses the angle across him and cuts the ball in the air towards third man
the slower bouncer beats Mahela but it's been called wide
he's connected with this! Flicking the ball from off stump with his wrists and sends it racing through square leg
Mahela has a flamboyant swing an a length ball that slants across him from Nannes, and makes contact with nothing
Jayawardene gets going by moving back and cutting the ball towards deep point
pushed to cover off the back foot
played towards point
huge appeal for lbw after the arm ball skids through on Mahela and catches him on the back foot, that looked very close, but perhaps an inside egde
McCullum stays in his crease and punches off the back foot to long off
McCullum strides forward to defend
caught! Laxman connects with the slog-sweep but hits it flat and in the air straight to the fielder at deep midwicket. Pujara barely had to move and took the catch easily
McCullum steps out and drives towards long-off for a single
played towards long-on for a single
that's a complete mis-hit and it falls in no-man's land. Laxman charges and aims for down the ground, he ends up slicing it in the air over the in-field at cover
played towards short fine leg
Dilshan aims for middle, Laxman aims for midwicket with a wristy flick off the front foot
Laxman drives inside out through extra cover
pushed off the front foot towards mid-on for a single
driven from the crease through cover

Laxman steps out, makes room, gets to the pitch of the ball, drives fluently to wide long-off and he might be run out! He didn't dive or put in a massive stretch while returning for the second but he's just safe. Just.
McCullum moves back and across and nudges the ball through midwicket
McCullum moves towards the ball and cuts towards point
Laxman tried to do it again but got beaten, de Villiers fumbled the take
delicate from Laxman, uses the pace and width outside off to dab the ball fine of the fielder at short third man. Laxman played that very late
Dilshan's bowling quick and McCullum turns it off his pads through square
McCullum moves back and across and nudges towards the leg side
driven off the front foot towards long off
played off the back foot behind point by angling the face of the bat
fuller ball outside off, McCullum drives off the front foot towards wide mid-off
that's a bit short, and McCullum's hammered it over the deep midwicket boundary. It wasn't that short but McCullum moves so quickly to create the time to pull
length ball with width outside off, McCullum stays in his crease and slaps it through extra cover for four
Mithun delivers from wide of the crease and Laxman opens the face to guide towards third man and bring up Kochi's 50
Laxman charges and tries to go over the off side but gets beaten by the extra bounce
Laxman's slogged it. It's a front-foot no ball as well. Length ball outside off stump, Laxman stays in his crease and flat-bats it over long-off
Mithun starts with a yorker which Laxman digs out
Dilshan is firing them in, Laxman goes back and drives to long-on
Laxman goes back and hits the ball towards mid-off
big bounce for Dilshan and he beats Laxman
Laxman gets down on one knee, gets under the ball, and lofts it cleanly over deep midwicket for six
huge appeal for lbw after Laxman pulls off the back foot and misses. The ball hits pad but that would have missed leg
played off the back foot towards point
played towards wide mid-on for a single
and again, VVS takes a step or two down, makes room and drives in the air towards long-off, Vettori's placed a fielder there but it falls well short
played back to the bowler
VVS! Lovely strike. He makes room by clearing his front foot and lofts the ball cleanly over the fielder at mid-off
McCullum nudges the ball off the front foot towards midwicket
McCullum leans forward to take it on the full and plays it towards the bowler
a slower ball outside off stump, Laxman gets under it and scoops it over cover
that's not that short but Laxman tries to pull anyway, makes contact and plays it to square leg
McCullum tries to work the ball through square but misses and gets hit on the pad, Laxman calls him through
McCullum charges and makes room by moving towards leg, the wily Zaheer follows and cramps him. McCullum defends
no room to work with there but McCullum still manages to play the square drive to point
length ball outside off, Laxman leans into a cover drive and hits it wide of the fielder at mid-off to take the single
played gently down the ground for a single to keep strike
Laxman pushes the ball from his crease towards mid-off
a full toss outside off stump, McCullum tries to hit it too hard and mis-times it towards mid-off
explosive! McCullum latches on to a short ball and sends it sky-rocketing over the deep midwicket boundary with a vicious pull
how New Zealand would have loved some of this a week or two ago, McCullum slashes at one and toe-ends it towards the third man boundary
full and wide outside off, McCullum stays in his crease and hammers the ball wide of the fielder at mid-off
good length on middle stump, Laxman nudges it off his pads. A gentle moment in this crash bang world
fuller length on middle and leg, McCullum wanted to hit straighter but ended up placing it to deep midwicket
good length and line, McCullum plays on the off side
charge! And slap! McCullum runs down the pitch at a length delivery, there's room outside off and McCullum flays hard at the ball, slapping it over cover for a one-bounce four
Zaheer gets some movement into the right hander but the line is too straight, the ball hits the pad and there's a leg bye for the taking
width offered outside off stump and McCullum slices it over the fielder at first slip, third man is fine enough to save it
full toss and Pathan ends it with a heave into that gap on the deep midwicket boundary, Bangalore have won, with plenty to spare
another short ball and Pathan has slugged it between deep midwicket and long-on, clean contact and looks like this game won't go into the final over
short ball and Pathan tries another pull but this time it doesn't come off, he was late on the shot and got hit on the body
wide outside off stump
short ball and Pathan has pulled it with power, RP runs to his left on the boundary but doesn't dive
and again! This time over wide long-on. de Villiers makes clean contact and dispatches Gomez for the third time. A loose full toss that was
that's full outside off, de Villiers stays in his crease, lines it up and launches it high and far over long-off, crucial strike
Tiwary tries to hit down the ground, a slog really, and ends up slicing it in the air towards cover, where Mahela back-pedals on the edge of the circle and holds the catch
much fuller this time, forcing de Villiers to hit towards long on

that's length at gentle medium pace, de Villiers clears his front foot out of the way and heaves the ball over deep midwicket. He's connected with the slog sweep supremely and the ball flies into the first tier
good length and straight, driven towards long off for a single. Big moment for Gomez to come into the attack.
driven straight to cover where a mis-field allows the ball to reach deep cover
Tiwary mis-hits the ball in the air but it falls safely over extra cover

de Villiers charges and tries to heave on the leg side, he gets an outside edge that goes in the air towards cover where Sreesanth runs to his left and dives. He gets his fingertips to the ball but can't hold on
de Villiers goes on the back foot and tries to pull but gets beaten by the doosra that spins across him
Tiwary plonks his foot forward and lifts the ball towards long-on
de Villiers plays a reverse hit towards short third man
and yet another full toss which isn't punished, hit to deep midwicket again
another quick full toss on leg and middle which Tiwary hits to deep midwicket
de Villiers swipes across the line and hits to deep midwicket
a full toss on leg stump which Tiwary should have hit for six. Instead he mis-times the heave towards deep midwicket
driven off the front foot towards long off
short and wide outside off, de Villiers slams it off the back foot towards cover where Mahela dives and saves
de Villiers steps out and drives another length ball through cover point. RP is rather monotonous with his length.
a slightly slower ball which Tiwary bashes off the front foot towards long-off
another length delivery, allowing Tiwary to swing freely, hitting the ball through midwicket
more length on leg stump, flicked off the pads through square leg, big over for Bangalore
length on off stump, Tiwary stands in his crease and frees his arms, dismissing the ball with immense power back over the bowler's head
this one is wide down leg side, Parthiv dives to his right to collect
RP Singh returns with rubbish on leg stump, Tiwary glances the ball off his hips between square leg and short fine leg
length delivery and Tiwary mashes it off the front foot towards the fielder at long-on
the slower ball and Tiwary hits the ball back at the bowler
hit hard into the ground and the ball lobs up towards mid-off for a quick single
length again on off, de Villiers made room and smashed the ball very hard towards cover, that was four if Mahela was not in the way
good length outside off, driven off the front foot towards extra cover
length ball outside off, Tiwary moves towards the line and then dabs towards point
driven off the front foot towards long off
Tiwary strides forward and defends with bat close to pad
Tiwary defends on the off side
played towards point
de Villiers charges, gets to the pitch of the ball and launches it powerfully over deep midwicket, superb golf-swing like strike
pushed off the back foot towards point
played off the pads towards square leg
driven to the fielder on the cover boundary
that's fired down leg side, hits the keeper's pads and goes to short fine leg, or did it hit the batsman's pads as he paddle-swept?
a low full toss and Tiwary drives towards long-on
fired in quick and straight, Tiwary defends on the off and wants one, de Villiers isn't interested
pushed towards covers for a single
de Villiers inside edges the one that goes straight through on to his pad
terrific over from Murali, the last ball is defended on the off side
he misses the arm ball from Murali and gets hit on the pad as he pushes forward, huge appeal for lbw
de Villiers moves back and works the ball to short fine leg
defended towards the bowler once again
driven back to the bowler
played towards midwicket on the front foot

Mayank falls! Caught at long-off. A full ball on off and middle, Mayank makes room and smashes it flat towards long off where Vinay Kumar holds an easy catch. And then he flings the ball into the ground in angry celebration.
driven back to the bowler
a quick full toss down leg side, de Villiers connects with the fine paddle sweep and hits it to short fine leg
quicker ball from over the wicket at 103 kph, de Villiers makes room and uses the pace to steer past short third man
played on the leg side off the front foot
played towards backward point
that's a slow and slightly high full toss, driven through cover
he's scooped that for six over fine leg! de Villiers got down low, took the ball on the full and scooped it cleanly over the boundary. Terrific execution.
a low full toss, and it's another no-ball, driven to long off for a single. Another free-hit coming up
de Villiers drives off the front foot through cover
another ball nearly in the blockhole, Mayank drives towards long-off
the yorker and de Villiers manages to dig it out with the bottom of his bat towards mid-on
that's a full toss on middle stump, the batsman makes room and slices it through cover point. Sreesanth had over-stepped. So free-hit coming up.
good length ball angles into the right-hander. Defended on the back foot
this time the ball jags in from a good length outside off and goes through the gap between bat and pad. Vinay joins his keeper late in the lbw appeal
that's a pacy delivery on a good length outside off, Mayank tries to drive but gets beaten

de Villiers dabs the ball close on the off side and responds to Mayank's call for a quick single. Vinay ran to the ball, picked up, dived and hit the stumps on his follow through but Mayank had also dived and was safe
length ball outside off, Mayank waits in his crease and guides the ball towards third man
Mayank tries to hook a bouncer but gets a top edge over the wicketkeeper
Mayank gets squared up and beaten
played to midwicket off the front foot
pushed off the front foot towards the off. de Villiers wants one but doesn't get it
de Villiers dabs the ball behind point and sets off with the intention of coming back for the second
played towards square leg for a single
cut off the back foot towards deep point
and Mayank takes him on! Planting his foot forward and lifting the ball off his pads over deep midwicket, huge hit, and off his first ball against Murali. That is some moment.
lovely crisp drive from de Villiers but he can't find the gap at point
Vinay swings the ball into the right-hander, de Villiers drives off the front foot to McCullum at cover
played off the front foot towards backward point

plumb lbw. Vinay Kumar skids the ball into the right-hander from outside off, Kohli moved across his stumps to flick the ball through square and missed. The ball crashed into the pads, Kohli was in his crease and that would have taken out leg stump
length ball and Kohli picks it up early, hoisting it off the front foot over midwicket for four.
length ball outside off, Kohli tries to pull but mis-times it
too short, and Mayank has smashed it off the back foot. Getting under the ball and heaving it over the deep midwicket boundary
dabbed off the back foot behind point for a single
full ball on middle and leg, driven through midwicket for one more
fired in flat on leg stump, played off the pads through midwicket
driven to cover off the front foot
Kohli goes inside out, up and over, and lofts his former India U-19 team-mate over extra cover. One-bounce four.
flicked towards deep midwicket for a single
too short and the line is on middle and leg, Kohli swivels and pulls the ball on one leg, using its pace, towards the long leg boundary. Fine leg was in the circle
good length on off stump, Kohli moves forward and across to drive the ball towards the electric Murali at mid-on. Murali's wearing a jersey with the number 800 on it.
good length ball outside off, Mayank steers the ball towards Jadeja's left at point and sets off for the single before Jadela can slide and save
too full and too far down leg side, Mayank moves across to flick but can't make contact
full ball on the pads and Kohli flicks the ball towards deep square
width offered outside off and Mayank steers the ball off the back foot towards point where Jadeja flies to his left to pull it down
short of a length ball on the hips, neatly tucked through square by Kohli
this time the ball doesn't come in and Kohli gets beaten outside off after he tried to hit the ball through point
RP once again cramps the right-hander by getting the ball to straighten after hitting the pitch, Mayank chops the ball down on the off
RP strays down leg side this time, Mayank misses the leg glance
Kohli tries to pull again but RP's angle back into the right-hander denies him the necessary room to make powerful contact
edged wide of the fielder at first slip for a single towards third man
that's banged in short, too short and the ball takes off, flying high over the batsman
Mayank stands in his crease and hits a length delivery through the line past mid-off for four
huge appeal for lbw from Sreesanth, who's down on one knee and pleading. Dharmasena says not out. The legcutter hit the batsman high on the pad
this time he's pulled it, and pulled it superbly between mid-on and midwicket. The length was short from Sreesanth and there wasn't much movement
Kohli plays an odd tennis forehand and mis-times the ball towards mid-off. He wanted to pull because of the short length but tried to bail after seeing the ball seam
major bounce outside off with serious seam movement, Kohli lets it go

caught at cover! Sreesanth brings Kochi alive. Dilshan gets a leading edge to an outswinger and McCullum dives forward to take a low and sharp catch. He was trying to whip that towards leg. The umpire Dharmasena wants to check if Sreesanth had over-stepped, he's ok, by the skin of his teeth
length ball outside off stump, Dilshan swishes and misses
mis-timed back towards the bowler
that was some ball! RP angles the ball across the right-hander, hits the pitch short of a length, and jags the ball back sharply, cutting the right-hander in half. It beats the keeper as well
Mayank plonks his front foot across his stumps and hits the ball hard to mid-on
Dilshan gets cramped for room once again and takes one hand off the bat as he plays towards the off side
this ball shapes into the right-hander and hits Dilshan high on the thigh
RP sprays the ball extremely wide outside off stump, will have to re-bowl that one
short, wide and slashed towards third man. Murali scoots to his left and picks up the speeding ball. He looks fit, and rather committed to the cause!
